Crawl Phase Demo

Phase 1: Crawl

Zero Trust Security via Capability Tokens

Crawl is the foundation of SatGate's maturity model. It proves we solve IAM scale problems today, without any Bitcoin or payment rail.

CISO Role

Issues root credentials. Retains authority. Agents cannot escalate.

Agent Role

Uses tokens. Can delegate restricted sub-tokens offline.

What You'll See:

  • ✓ Stateless credential issuance (no database)
  • ✓ Instant cryptographic validation
  • ✓ Offline token delegation (zero network calls)
  • ✓ Mathematical scope enforcement
